meta.purpose: Competitors' own reported numbers (no reimplementation), chair-plan item 8 second half; user decision (2)
meta.method: Primary sources read by a research subagent (local PDFs of MDI-MIMO and PIMI v2; arXiv full texts; author PDFs; abstract/metadata APIs where paywalled); no curl/wget downloads; PIMI Table S3 and MDI Table I / 2-omega sentence / Fig. 5-6 axis labels re-checked by hand against the local text and page-9 raster images

labels.VERIFIED-primary: read in the primary source at the stated location
labels.(read): figure reading; MDI-MIMO readings from our digitization (+-0.1 dB, +-0.02 dec), others from the subagent (+-0.5-1 dB)
labels.DERIVED: computed from the paper's numbers, not stated by it

meta.snr_convention: Ours: SNR = Nt*Es/N0 per receive antenna (received SNR per antenna). Princeton/Cornell (MDI-MIMO Figs. 5-6, PIMI): axis "Eb/N0" with received SNR = b*Eb/N0, b = log2 M => Eb/N0 = SNR - 6.02 dB (16-QAM), - 3.01 dB (QPSK). PIMI defines it (App. 15); MDI-MIMO never defines its Eb/N0 axis.

comparability: Quality only on the same SNR convention and channel class (PIMI, MDI-MIMO, DU-SB, HOPbit 16x16: i.i.d. Rayleigh/flat fading with true H; MMGaP: UMi with ideal estimation and no BER; DOIM50: correlated, best of 30 + post-processing)
Throughput/latency reported only by PIMI (FPGA per instance per kernel), MMGaP (A100 slot time, 8x8 coded system) and the ASICs; MDI-MIMO, SB, HOPbit, DOIM50 report none
Energy reported only by ASICs (70-430 pJ/b); PIMI, MMGaP, MDI-MIMO report none; our GPU numbers are ~6-7 orders above the ASICs per bit, so energy statements must stay relative and scoped
discrepancies: MDI-MIMO Figs. 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 13 labelled "Eb/N0" (undefined); the "SNR (received power to noise power)" sentence (Sec. V-B p. 9) belongs to the Fig. 7 LISA comparison (axis "SNR")
MDI-MIMO Sec. IV-B p. 6: "2w = 4 for 16-QAM" contradicts its definition (6); with 4 the radius never reaches R_max = 3; we use 6; cost measured (ambt_om2)
MDI-MIMO x/e init "N(0, 0.001)": variance vs sd unstated; we use variance; dev check shows sd reading much worse; held-out cost measured (ambt_x0sd)
MDI-MIMO "Ns" overloaded (spins in Sec. III-A, anneals per stage in Sec. IV-C); Table I caption mentions run time but none is reported
PIMI throughput defined per trial (App. 1.5) vs per instance (App. 20); Tables S1-S4 per instance (32 trials)
PIMI Fig. 6 caption says FPGA-measured BER; our milestone-D check found the archived report.json data behind Fig. 6 are Python-emulation outputs (verified_mimo_20261017/RESULTS.md secs. 21, 23)

MMGaP: "about 30 A100s" (Sec. 5.4) vs Fig. 13 fit crossing 0.5 ms at ~33-35 GPUs (read); 50 MHz "15 A100s" not in Sec. 5.3; reviewer "~1e6 8x8 det/s per A100" not in paper, Fig. 13 implies ~2.2-2.7e6 (DERIVED)
DOIM: the reviewer task description (16-user QPSK, 64 Rx, 250 instances, 30 attempts) is DOIM50, not DOIM140
Tang/Chen/Zhang (0.58 mm2, 2.76 Gb/s, 79.8 pJ/b) is VLSI 2016 (40 nm) and JSSC 2021; Tang ISSCC18 70.6 pJ/b correct
